reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "[plugins] Upgrade http-wasm host to v0.6.0 to support clients using v0.4.0 (#10475 by jcchavezs)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Traefik plugin support improves to maintain compatibility with http-wasm clients using v0.4.0 while running on the v0.6.0 host.

proposed.statement: Traefik 3.0.0 upgrades the http-wasm host to v0.6.0 to support clients using v0.4.0.
